body:
Source: repository maintenance audit (tools over-engineering review, finding 1). CONVENTIONS.md Rule 2 requires shared helpers to live in @adlc/core rather than being copied across packages. Three helpers currently have redundant duplicate implementations: activeTickets (model-router, merge-forecast, coldstart), isPlainObject (backlog-groom, coldstart, quartermaster), and OpError (backlog-groom).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add activeTickets(tickets) to packages/core/lib/tickets.mjs and export it from packages/core/index.mjs and packages/core/index.d.ts.
2. Add isPlainObject(value) and OpError (class extending Error with isOpError = true) to packages/core/lib/cli.mjs, and export them from packages/core/index.mjs and packages/core/index.d.ts.
3. Add unit tests for all three helpers in packages/core/test/helpers-promotion.test.mjs.
4. Remove packages/model-router/lib/active-tickets.mjs, packages/merge-forecast/lib/active-tickets.mjs, and packages/coldstart/lib/active-tickets.mjs, as well as their duplicate test files. Update each package to import activeTickets from @adlc/core.
5. Update packages/fleet/lib/quartermaster.mjs to import activeTickets from @adlc/core.
6. Remove packages/backlog-groom/lib/op-error.mjs and update its callers to import OpError / opError from @adlc/core.
7. Remove local isPlainObject functions in packages/backlog-groom, packages/coldstart, and packages/quartermaster, importing from @adlc/core instead.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Promoted helpers unit test passes. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/helpers-promotion.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC2 All local active-tickets modules and tests are deleted. verify: `test ! -e packages/model-router/lib/active-tickets.mjs && test ! -e packages/merge-forecast/lib/active-tickets.mjs && test ! -e packages/coldstart/lib/active-tickets.mjs`
- AC3 Consumer packages tests pass green. verify: `npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w packages/model-router && npm test -w packages/merge-forecast && npm test -w packages/coldstart && npm test -w packages/backlog-groom && npm test -w packages/quartermaster && npm test -w packages/fleet` exits 0.
- AC4 Type declarations updated. verify: `grep -q activeTickets packages/core/index.d.ts && grep -q isPlainObject packages/core/index.d.ts && grep -q OpError packages/core/index.d.ts`
- AC5 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0.
title: refactor(core): promote activeTickets, isPlainObject, and OpError into @adlc/core
